targetText: History does nothing, it "possesses no immense wealth", it "wages no battles". It is man, real, living man who does all that, who possesses and fights; "history" is not, as it were, a person apart, using man as a means to achieve its own aims; history is nothing but the activity of man pursuing his aims.
explanation: Famous materialist definition of history: history is not an abstract teleological force, but the active, conscious struggle of real living human beings pursuing material interests.
